connect4.shareLinkDesc: Share the invite link with your opponent!
connect4.title: Connect4
connect4.description: Play real-time Connect4 with friends. Connect 4 discs of your color in a row on a 7x6 board to win!
connect4.confirmSurrender: Are you sure you want to surrender?
connect4.sharePeerId: Share this Peer ID with your opponent:

rules.rule1: Players take turns dropping colored discs into a 7-column, 6-row grid.
rules.rule2: Discs fall to the lowest available space in the column.
rules.rule3: First player to connect 4 discs in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) wins!
rules.rule4: If the board fills up with no winner, the game is a draw.
